title: Saona Island Tour
description:
**Your dream Caribbean escape, just a boat ride away.** Sail away to **Saona Island**, a jewel of the Dominican Republic nestled within the protected waters of **Cotubanamá National Park**. With its powdery white-sand beaches, turquoise waters, and towering coconut palms, Saona offers the ultimate tropical experience that feels straight out of a postcard.

### What’s in Store

Departing from Bayahibe, this full-day adventure takes you to the **largest island** in the Dominican Republic — a serene haven covering over 110 km². Whether you’re here to relax, explore, or snorkel, there’s something for every kind of traveler.

**Catamaran & Speedboat Ride** — Enjoy two scenic rides — one relaxing, one thrilling — to and from the island.

**Natural Pool Stop** — Wade into shallow, crystal-clear waters known for their giant starfish. A picture-perfect moment!

**Beach Time** — Lounge under palm trees, swim in the warm Caribbean Sea, or stroll along the untouched coastline.

**Marine Life** — Snorkel in calm waters and discover colorful coral reefs and tropical fish.

**Island Lunch** — Savor a delicious Dominican buffet lunch served right on the beach. An open bar is included!

**Duration:** 9 hours

**Departs from:** Bayahíbe

**Prices:** Adults (11+ years) $65 · Children $40 · Infants (0–2 years) free

**Included:**
• Round-trip hotel transportation
• Round-trip catamaran and speedboat rides
• Stop at the natural swimming pool
• Beach time on Saona Island
• Buffet lunch and open bar
• Entertainment and music onboard
• Certified guides

**What to bring:**
• Beach clothes
• Towels
• Sunglasses
• Sun protection
• Cash for tipping

title: Dorado Park
description:
**Dorado Park Punta Cana – Family Fun for Everyone**
Get ready for a day packed with laughter, games, and unforgettable memories at Dorado Park Punta Cana, a top family entertainment spot in the heart of Bávaro. Whether you’re with kids, friends, or a special someone, this park blends fun and relaxation in a safe and colorful setting.

**What You’ll Experience**
Dorado Park is full of exciting attractions for all ages—race your friends in go-karts, bounce high on bungee trampolines, enjoy classic bumper cars, dive into inflatable play zones, explore arcade games, or visit the friendly animals in the mini-zoo. There’s something for every adventurer.

**Duration:** 8 hours

**Departs from:** Punta Cana

**Prices:** Adults (11+ years) $129 · Children (3–11 years) $65 · Infants (0–2 years) free

**Included:**
• Pick-up and drop-off from your hotel
• Entrance to Dorado Park Punta Cana
• Access to attractions based on your chosen package
• Fun activities for both kids and adults
• Safety gear for rides and games
• On-site staff for support
• Food and drinks available for purchase
• Certified tour guides

**What to bring:**
• Comfortable clothes
• Towel
• Sunglasses
• Sunscreen
• Some cash for tips or snacks

title: Santo Domingo Tour
description:
**Step Into History and Culture in the Heart of the Caribbean**

Santo Domingo de Guzmán, the vibrant capital of the Dominican Republic, is the oldest continuously inhabited city in the Americas. As the birthplace of the New World, it is a treasure trove of history, culture, and stunning colonial architecture. The city’s historic center, the Colonial Zone, is a UNESCO World Heritage Site filled with relics of its 16th-century past. Among the most famous landmarks is the **Catedral Primada de América**, the first cathedral ever built in the Americas.

The city is a bustling metropolis with a population of around 3 million, divided into various municipalities, including Santo Domingo Este, the National District, Santo Domingo Oeste, and Santo Domingo Norte. While the city thrives with modern developments, its past is never too far from view.

**Duration:** 10 hours

**Departs from:** Santo Domingo

**Prices:** Adults (11+ years) $90 · Children (3–11 years) $45 · Infants (0–2 years) free

**Included:**
• Hotel pick-up and drop-off
• Air-conditioned transportation
• Certified guide
• Visits to the Colonial Zone landmarks, including:
• Catedral Primada de América
• Alcázar de Colón
• Ozama Fortress
• Parque Colón and Plaza de España
• A walking tour through the cobblestone streets of the Colonial Zone
• Time to explore local markets, squares, and cafes
• Hotel pick-up and dropoff
• Soft Drinks
• Typical dominican lunch

**What to bring:**
• Beach clothes
• Towels
• Sunglasses
• Sun protection
• Cash for tipping

title: Punta Cana Party Boat
description:

We’ll cruise along the breathtaking coastline, surrounded by swaying palm trees and vibrant scenery. Our energetic crew of entertainers will keep the vibes high with a mix of bachata, merengue, reggaeton, salsa, and international hits. The music, the views, and the energy are unmatched!

title: Adventure Boogies
description:
Choose Your Style of Adventure — An Unforgettable Off-Road Experience!. Get ready for an adrenaline-packed day on the rugged roads of Punta Cana! With **Adventure Boogies**, you’ll have the opportunity to explore the stunning landscapes, immerse yourself in Dominican culture, and unleash your adventurous spirit on an off-road tour like no other.

You’ll drive through muddy trails, vibrant local villages, and lush tropical paths, visiting fascinating locations like a **natural cave** with crystal-clear waters. To top it off, you’ll enjoy some relaxation time at **Macao Beach**, one of the Dominican Republic’s most beautiful beaches.

This tour caters to every kind of adventurer, whether you’re going solo, as a couple, with family, or as a group of friends. Choose from four different ride options, each designed to suit your needs and make your experience memorable:

### Choose Your Ride

### 🚙 Single Buggy – $85 per person

Perfect for those who love the thrill of full control. Drive solo and navigate the trails on your own!

### 🚙 Double Buggy – $60 per person

Ideal for couples or friends who want to share the ride and the adventure.

### 🚙 Family Buggy – $45 per person (up to 4 people)

The best option for families or small groups looking for extra space and safety while exploring the countryside.

### 🚜 Safari Buggy – $89 per person

For those who want a longer, more immersive tour with added cultural stops, tastings of local products, and deeper interaction with rural communities. This version of the tour also includes a **horseback ride**, a **zipline adventure**, and **refreshments** along the way.

**Duration:** 4 hours

**Departs from:** Punta Cana

**Prices:** Single boogie $85 · Double boogie (60 x pax) $60 · Family boogie $45 · Boogie + safari $89

**Included:**
• Hotel pick-up and dropoff
• Exciting buggie ride
• Swim in a cenote
• Visit to a typical store
• Specialized equipment included
• Entrance to domitai
• Certified guides

**What to bring:**
• Beach clothes
• Towels
• Sunglasses
• Sun protection
• Cash for tipping
• Safety gear
• Clothes you don’t mind getting muddy (it’s part of the fun!)

title: Catalina Island Tour
description:
**A Hidden Gem of the Caribbean.** Discover the magic of Catalina Island — a stunning tropical escape located just off the southeastern coast of the Dominican Republic, near La Romana. Famous for its crystal-clear turquoise waters, powdery white sand, and vibrant coral reefs, Catalina Island is a dream destination for beach lovers, snorkeling enthusiasts, and those simply in search of peace and natural beauty.

Your journey begins with a scenic speed boat ride across the Caribbean Sea. Along the way, we’ll stop at the breathtaking **Natural Pool**, a shallow sandbar where you can wade in the water, sip a drink, and soak in the sunshine — a true slice of paradise!

Once on Catalina Island, you’ll enjoy a **laid-back beach day** with plenty of time to relax, swim, explore the island, or snorkel in the vibrant reefs teeming with marine life. Keep an eye out for colorful tropical fish and perhaps even the remains of the legendary “Captain Kidd” shipwreck!

**Duration:** 9 hours

**Departs from:** Bayahíbe

**Prices:** Adults (11+ years) $115 · Children (3–11 years) $60 · Infants (0–2 years) free

**Included:**
• Hotel pick-up and drop-off
• Round-trip speed boat ride
• Stop at the Natural Pool
• Delicious buffet lunch on the island
• Open bar (beer, rum, water, soft drinks)
• Free time to enjoy Catalina Island’s beach and reef
• Entertainment staff and certified guides
• Animation and entertainment staff

**What to bring:**
• Beach clothes
• Towels
• Sunglasses
• Sun protection
• Cash for tipping
